strictRules: No duplicate full SKU, including /WA and /GL suffixes
EAN is manufacturer-published per exact product page; no fabricated identifiers
Keep differences in battery mAh and included charger as different physical article SKUs
No generic family compatibility implies exact model fitment
New articles have zero direct model relationships, even when older catalog devices share a family
Do not offer live price, stock, delivery, sellers or confirmed individual fitment
No Jet Bot robot accessories; no floor-care devices outside initial vacuum scope
